comment: The second API category suggests foundational-DPI authorities might consume patient-matching, facility, workforce, and terminology APIs. Some of these uses may exceed their mandate or create unnecessary cross-sector access to sensitive health information.

anchor.note: p.97 l.Lines 353-361 read as the printed page; section 4.3.4 agrees

public.text: The second API category suggests foundational-DPI authorities might consume patient-matching, facility, workforce, and terminology APIs. Some of these uses may exceed their mandate or create unnecessary cross-sector access to sensitive health information.
public.suggestedRevision: Require purpose limitation, minimum necessary access, legal authority, documented use cases, and privacy-impact assessment before exposing health-sector services to foundational-DPI authorities.
